channel.description: Latest articles from Lucky Dog Publishing (luckydognews.com)

item.title: A Fluffy Weekend Ahead
item.description: A major snowstorm will affect all of South Carolina from Friday night into Saturday morning, and it will last into Saturday night or Sunday morning. The entire state is under a Winter Storm Warning.

item.title: 1/30 TOKI Weather Alert: Bitterly Cold Temperatures & Possible Snow
item.description: The Kiawah Island Emergency Management team along with our Charleston County partners are closely monitoring the winter storm. A Winter Storm Warning and Extreme Cold Watch are currently in effect for Charleston County.

item.title: Sullivan's Island Public Safety Provides Winter Storm Warning and Cold Weather Advisory
item.description: As of the 2 PM briefing, NWS - Charleston is still forecasting heavy snow for our area with accumulation up to 4 inches. At its heaviest, we could see snowfall rates as heavy a 1 inch per hour.

item.title: 1/31 Town of Kiawah Island Winter Weather Alert
item.description: The Kiawah Island Emergency Management team along with our Charleston County partners continue monitoring the winter storm. A Winter Storm Warning and Extreme Cold Watch remain in effect through 1:00 p.m. Sunday.

item.title: Stono Bridge and Limehouse Bridge Closed
item.description: Both the Stono Bridge and Limehouse Bridge have been shut down until further notice due to dangerous road conditions and extremely low temperatures. The Kiawah Island Parkway bridge may also be icy — use extreme caution.

item.title: Hidden Hearts: A Valentine’s Day Scavenger Hunt on the Island
item.description: Valentine’s Day on the island has never been about grand gestures or over-the-top romance. It’s about sunset walks, familiar faces, small businesses we love and finding joy in the little things.

item.title: 2025 Exchange Club Scholarships Winners Update Members on First Year at College
item.description: To kick off the Oyster Roast fundraiser, Isle of Palms Exchange Club members viewed nine videos submitted by the 2025 scholarship recipients. In the videos, the students thanked Exchange Club members for the scholarships awarded in April 2025

item.title: City of Isle of Palms Recreation Department to Host Cars in the Park
item.description: The City of Isle of Palms Recreation Department will host the second annual Cars in the Park event Saturday, April 25, 2026, from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the Isle of Palms Recreation Center.

item.title: Message From The Sullivan's Island Mayor
item.description: Please be aware that scammers have been targeting some residents with business before the town. Using email addresses obtained from public records on the town’s website — such as applications to the Design Review Board and Board of Zoning Appeals

item.title: Reddy or Not: Assault on Property Rights
item.description: I hope you are all paying attention to what I believe is an assault on property rights happening before our eyes. Freedom and property rights, which are intricately linked, do not disappear overnight.
